mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM QR_VISIT_LOG WHERE EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} AND EVENT_STATUS = 'P'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM QR_VISIT_LOG v INNER JOIN SURVEY_MASTER m ON v.EVENT_SEQ = m.EVENT_SEQ WHERE BINARY m.AUTH_CODE_URL = #{authCodeUrl} AND v.EVENT_STATUS = 'P'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM QR_VISIT_LOG WHERE SEQ = ( SELECT seq FROM ( SELECT v.SEQ FROM QR_VISIT_LOG v INNER JOIN SURVEY_MASTER m ON v.EVENT_SEQ = m.EVENT_SEQ WHERE BINARY m.AUTH_CODE_URL = #{authCodeUrl} AND v.EVENT_STATUS = 'P' ORDER BY v.SEQ DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS temp )
